query:
SELECT 
  'intake' as type, id, sponsorId, submittedAt 
FROM intakeSubmissions 
WHERE sponsorId IN (SELECT id FROM sponsors WHERE contactEmail = 'bobby@recruitmentevents.co')
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'rankings' as type, id, sponsorId, submittedAt 
FROM rankingsSubmissions 
WHERE sponsorId IN (SELECT id FROM sponsors WHERE contactEmail = 'bobby@recruitmentevents.co')
ORDER BY type, submittedAt;
